mapper.select: SELECT t.*, o.position_side, o.reduce_only, e.operation_type, o.leverage_snapshot, o.price_tick_size_snapshot, o.post_fill_wallet_balance, o.post_fill_balance_at, qs.price_tick_size AS current_price_tick_size FROM ( SELECT * FROM quant_trade WHERE credential_id IN #{id} AND symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY trade_time, exchange_trade_id, id LIMIT 20001 ) t LEFT JOIN quant_order o ON o.credential_id = t.credential_id AND o.symbol = t.symbol AND o.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN quant_execution_record e ON e.credential_id = t.credential_id AND e.symbol = t.symbol AND e.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id AND e.operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') LEFT JOIN quant_symbol qs ON qs.symbol = t.symbol ORDER BY t.trade_time, t.exchange_trade_id, t.id LIMIT 20001
